description.p: Wightwatch Keep is an open source, puzzle-platformer inspired by NES-era games like Castlevania and Adventures of Lolo as well as older style visuals.

Your goal is to find the key and reveal the exit on each of the 25 floors within the tower before facing the menacing wight on the 26th floor. There are 5 themed zones, each consisting of 5 levels: the crypt, the garden, the corrupted sanctuary, the guard's quarters, and the alchemist's lab.
Many obstacles and enemies will be in your way before you can purge the evil from the tower. Find the keys, solve the puzzles, and defeat the wight!

ul.li: Added a tutorial screen when the game launches to help clarify the controls (based on user feedback)
Switched from integer to fractional scaling for those with resolutions that don't scale cleanly
Fixed gamepads not being seen in the flatpak version
Improved the platform timing on level 9
Made the input mapping match what was displayed on the tutorial page
